core_struggle: Keeps swinging between crash diets and binge eating, and between all-nighters and oversleeping, asking for balance.
mirror: One day you crash the diet, the next you binge. One night you burn the lamp, the next you sleep through it.

queries.hook: The swing between extremes that leaves you exhausted and out of control, caught between what you deny and what you give in to.
queries.diagnose: Desire feeds on itself; the more the senses chase, the more they want, and the mind is never satisfied, so the swing never stops.
queries.steady: The self is never the enemy of the self; what you are is not your hunger, and it can be steady even when the habits are not.
queries.act: Practise moderation in what you eat and sleep; let the day have its own rhythm and do not let desire drive it.
queries.story: A person who let desire rule their days and nights, lost to their own body, and who found their way back to balance through one steady choice.

weeks: The self is not the enemy
bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call wanting that never settles, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: Over seven days the swing between extremes names itself, and the middle becomes a place you can stand.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the swing and the exhaustion, named without judgement.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the crash and the binge are two sides of the same hunger that never settles.
week_beats.steady: You hold that the self is not the enemy of the self, and that balance is a truth you can return to.
week_beats.act: You try one practice of moderation, one steady meal, one set hour of sleep, and let the day have its own rhythm.
week_beats.story: A person who lost themselves to extremes shows you what returning to the middle looks like.

insight: You swing between extremes because the middle feels unsafe. The texts call this desire that never settles.
seat: someone caught in a cycle of extreme habits that swing from one to the other
life_context: Someone caught in a cycle of extreme habits that swing from one to the other; they are asking what the texts say about finding balance in daily life.
details: keeps swinging between crash diets and binge eating
asks about balance in daily habits
